verdict.rationale: Digits documents its own month-end close workflow. It starts reconciliation before month-end, generates accrual and depreciation schedules from ledger activity, runs quality control and surfaces exceptions, and firm plans add task management. However, no evidence shows an explicit close checklist or reviewer sign-off tracking; the close is described as an automated agentic flow rather than a tracked checklist. Missing for 10: a documented close checklist with per-item status, review/approval sign-offs on close tasks, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
